Commons applies PD-EU-audio and identifies Meyer’s 29–⁠30 October 1953 session and Les Discophiles Français DF 98/99. The 2015 digital-item date is not the recording date. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
